description: Premium visual design overhaul - ultra-elegant dark theme with Bloomberg Terminal meets Apple design language aesthetics. Refined typography, subtle gradients, smooth micro-interactions, polished loading states, premium card designs, and enhanced color system.
steps: Step 1: Update `app/globals.css` - (a) Add a premium font import (Inter from Google Fonts via @import). (b) Enhance the gradient-mesh background with richer, more layered gradients (add a fourth radial gradient, slow down animation to 30s). (c) Add new utility classes: `.glass-premium` (stronger blur, more border glow), `.shimmer-loading` (animated shimmer gradient for loading skeletons), `.text-glow` (subtle text-shadow glow). (d) Add premium scrollbar styles (thinner, more translucent). (e) Add a `.card-hover-glow` class that adds an animated border glow on hover matching the card's category color.

Step 2: Update `tailwind.config.js` - (a) Add Inter font family. (b) Add new animations: `fadeIn`, `slideUp`, `scaleIn`, `borderGlow`. (c) Add richer color palette: deeper dark background variants (dark-900: '#06060a', dark-800: '#0d0d14'), accent gradients. (d) Add backdrop-blur variants (3xl: 48px). (e) Add custom box-shadow values for premium glow effects.

Step 3: Update `app/layout.tsx` - (a) Add Inter font via next/font/google. (b) Apply the font class to the body. (c) Add a subtle noise texture overlay (CSS-only using repeating SVG pattern at very low opacity) for premium depth. (d) Ensure the gradient-mesh is layered properly.

Step 4: Redesign `components/Sidebar.tsx` - (a) Add a subtle top-to-bottom gradient on the sidebar background. (b) Upgrade the QuantFeed logo area with a more premium animated gradient text effect. (c) Add hover states with subtle glow on active item. (d) Add a 'Last Updated' timestamp that shows actual time since last data fetch (use a prop or static display). (e) Add subtle separator lines between navigation sections. (f) Improve the AI Status indicator at the bottom with a small animated pulse ring.

Step 5: Redesign `components/NewsCard.tsx` - (a) Add a left border color accent matching the category. (b) Add a subtle gradient overlay on hover. (c) Improve tag pill styling with slightly translucent category-colored backgrounds. (d) Add a small freshness indicator dot next to the date (green=today, amber=1-2 days, gray=older). (e) Improve expand/collapse animation smoothness. (f) Add the relevanceScore as a small secondary metric next to impact score.

Step 6: Redesign `components/DailySummary.tsx` - (a) Add richer gradient cards for economic indicators with subtle animated borders. (b) Make the sentiment badge larger and more prominent with an animated background gradient. (c) Add number transition animations for indicator values. (d) Improve the key takeaways list with numbered items and subtle left border accents.

Step 7: Update `app/page.tsx` (Dashboard) - (a) Add a premium hero section at the top with a large gradient headline and the current date. (b) Improve the quick stats cards with animated counters and category-specific gradient accents. (c) Add subtle entrance animations with staggered timing. (d) Improve spacing and visual hierarchy between sections.

Step 8: Create `components/LoadingSkeleton.tsx` - Create a reusable shimmer loading skeleton component. Multiple variants: (a) `CardSkeleton` - mimics news card shape with animated shimmer. (b) `StatSkeleton` - mimics stat card. (c) `GraphSkeleton` - full-width with pulsing nodes animation. Use these in place of the basic Loader2 spinners across all pages.

Step 9: Update loading states across all pages - Replace the simple `<Loader2>` spinners in `app/page.tsx`, `app/news/page.tsx`, `app/network/page.tsx`, `app/predictions/page.tsx` with the new LoadingSkeleton variants. Add smooth fade-in transitions when data loads.

Step 10: Final polish - (a) In `app/network/page.tsx`, add a subtle animated particle overlay behind the graph. (b) In `app/predictions/page.tsx`, improve the prediction cards with animated confidence rings that fill on mount. (c) Ensure all pages have consistent spacing (py-8 lg:py-10 for main content). (d) Add smooth page transitions using framer-motion AnimatePresence if not already present.
acceptance_criteria: Inter font is loaded and applied globally
Glass components have enhanced blur and border effects
Loading states use shimmer skeleton components instead of spinner icons
Sidebar has premium gradient styling and animated elements
NewsCard has category-colored left border accent and freshness dot indicator
Dashboard has improved visual hierarchy with gradient hero section
All animations are smooth (no janky transitions)
DailySummary economic indicators have animated gradient card borders
Project builds successfully with `npx next build`
